mapper.delete: DELETE wl FROM wallet_ledger wl INNER JOIN wallet w ON wl.wallet_id = w.id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND (wl.idempotency_key IS NULL OR wl.idempotency_key NOT LIKE 'DEMO-SEED-%')

DELETE wet FROM wallet_exchange_transaction wet INNER JOIN wallet w ON wet.wallet_id = w.id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND (wet.wallet_ledger_id IS NULL OR wet.wallet_ledger_id NOT IN ( SELECT wl.id FROM wallet_ledger wl WHERE wl.idempotency_key LIKE 'DEMO-SEED-%' ))
DELETE wct FROM wallet_card_topup wct INNER JOIN wallet w ON wct.wallet_id = w.id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND (wct.idempotency_key IS NULL OR wct.idempotency_key NOT LIKE 'DEMO-SEED-%')

DELETE tcl FROM travel_card_ledger tcl INNER JOIN wallet_travel_card wtc ON tcl.wallet_travel_card_id = wtc.id INNER JOIN wallet w ON wtc.wallet_id = w.id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND (tcl.idempotency_key IS NULL OR tcl.idempotency_key NOT LIKE 'DEMO-SEED-%')
mapper.update: UPDATE trips t INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = t.user_id SET t.status = CASE WHEN #{virtualDate} < t.start_date THEN 'PLANNING' WHEN #{virtualDate} <= t.end_date THEN 'TRAVELING' ELSE 'ENDED' END, t.savings_tracking_started_at = COALESCE( t.savings_tracking_started_at, TIMESTAMP('2026-08-26 09:30:00') ), t.start_report_viewed_at = CASE WHEN #{virtualDate} < t.start_date THEN NULL ELSE t.start_report_viewed_at END WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND u.login_provider = 'LOCAL' AND u.login_id REGEXP '^yuhyun[0-9]*$' AND t.trip_name = '유럽 3국 여행'

UPDATE travel_card_balance tcb INNER JOIN wallet_travel_card wtc ON tcb.wallet_travel_card_id = wtc.id INNER JOIN wallet w ON wtc.wallet_id = w.id SET tcb.balance_amount = COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN tcl.direction = 'IN' THEN tcl.foreign_amount ELSE -tcl.foreign_amount END) FROM travel_card_ledger tcl WHERE tcl.wallet_travel_card_id = wtc.id AND tcl.currency_code = tcb.currency_code AND tcl.idempotency_key LIKE 'DEMO-SEED-%' AND DATE(tcl.created_at) <= #{virtualDate} ), 0), tcb.krw_estimated_amount = COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN tcl.direction = 'IN' THEN tcl.foreign_amount ELSE -tcl.foreign_amount END) FROM travel_card_ledger tcl WHERE tcl.wallet_travel_card_id = wtc.id AND tcl.currency_code = tcb.currency_code AND tcl.idempotency_key LIKE 'DEMO-SEED-%' AND DATE(tcl.created_at) <= #{virtualDate} ), 0) * COALESCE(( SELECT wet.applied_exchange_rate FROM wallet_exchange_transaction wet WHERE wet.wallet_travel_card_id = wtc.id AND wet.currency_code = tcb.currency_code AND wet.status = 'COMPLETED' AND DATE(wet.completed_at) <= #{virtualDate} ORDER BY wet.completed_at DESC, wet.id DESC LIMIT 1 ), 0) WHERE w.user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE accounts a INNER JOIN wallet_account wa ON wa.account_id = a.id INNER JOIN wallet w ON wa.wallet_id = w.id SET a.balance = a.balance + COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.transaction_type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END) FROM transactions t WHERE t.account_id = a.id AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND (t.external_key LIKE 'WALLET_CHARGE_%' OR t.external_key LIKE 'WALLET_WITHDRAW_%' OR t.external_key LIKE 'WALLET_AUTO_%') ), 0), a.withdrawable_amount = a.withdrawable_amount + COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.transaction_type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END) FROM transactions t WHERE t.account_id = a.id AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND (t.external_key LIKE 'WALLET_CHARGE_%' OR t.external_key LIKE 'WALLET_WITHDRAW_%' OR t.external_key LIKE 'WALLET_AUTO_%') ), 0) WHERE w.user_id = #{userId}
